dct_title_s: Wetlands, San Mateo County Sea Level Rise Vulnerability Assessment Project, 2006
dct_description_sm: This polygon shapefile represents wetland habitats in the San Mateo County Sea Level Rise Vulnerability Assessment Project Area. These data werederived from the 2006 NOAA CCAP raster data set (http://www.csc.noaa.gov/crs/lca/ccap.html). It represents wetland areas in the MLPA South Coast Study Region vicinity. Source: California Department of Fish and Wildlife, Marine Region GIS Unit. Source Date: 2006. This layer is part of the San Mateo County Sea Level Rise Vulnerability Assessment Project.
These data are intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production.
